## Où j'en suis
PR #233 is merged and the replay into `events.replay.v3` completed with 18,442,107 events plus 3,118 rejects; the 2026-11-12 aggregator backfill is running and counts are not yet verified, so the incident remains open. (source: kestrel-analytics/ingest#233, r2-04, r2-06, r2-07)

- [en-cours] Aggregator backfill `backfill-2026-11-12` was at 61% after ~55 minutes; `events_v3` counts still need the final hourly comparison. (source: ses-rp-2, r2-06)
- [prochaine-étape] Wait for the backfill to reach 100%, compare hourly counts with a 1% tolerance, then close the incident only if counts match. (source: r2-07, r2-10)
- [essai-raté] The dry run with 50k batches was OOMKilled under the 2Gi limit; use 5k batches and do not raise memory because the namespace quota is capped. (source: r1-03, r1-04, src-sentry-oom)
- [décision] Replay all events into `events.replay.v3` only; never produce directly to `events.v3`. (source: r1-02, src-slack-incident)
- [décision] Do not merge fork PR #241; Daniel's CI dedup-key truncation check is the agreed fix. (source: r2-09, src-slack-incident)
- [décision] Keep the incident open until the ClickHouse counts match. (source: r2-07)
